svg.aria-label: The square from -1 to 1 that holds an octahedral normal: the diamond |x| + |y| <= 1 inside it is the upper half of the sphere, +z at its centre, and the four corner triangles are the lower half folded out, -z at the corners. The normal (0.6, 0, 0.8) lands at (0.4286, 0), and its mirror (0.6, 0, -0.8) folds out to (1, 0.5714).
